description: Support operations workspace for routing unassigned Freshdesk tickets to the correct queues based on customer tier and queue routing configuration. The assistant can read the unassigned ticket queue, the customer tier and queue-config worksheets, and supporting directory/policy material, and can prepare a routing plan for review. High-impact actions (reassigning tickets, writing 'routed' notes to live tickets, posting summaries to Slack) are available but must not be taken before user approval.

ws_queue_config.content: Worksheet ws_queue_config in spreadsheet ss_customers. Routing rules (evaluated top to bottom, first match wins): 1) tier=Enterprise-Plus OR priority=Urgent -> queue 'Q-Premier'; 2) tier in {Enterprise} -> queue 'Q-Enterprise'; 3) tier=Business -> queue 'Q-Business'; 4) tier in {Starter} -> queue 'Q-SelfServe'; 5) subject contains 'Feature request' -> queue 'Q-Product'; 6) no tier on file -> queue 'Q-Triage' and flag for CSM assignment.

routing_policy.content: Support Routing Policy v3.1. Tickets must be routed within SLA windows (Urgent 30m, High 2h). Routing config in ws_queue_config is authoritative; agents must not override. 'Routed' internal notes are written by the routing automation only after assignment is confirmed. Routing summaries are posted to #support-routing once per routing run.

slack_channels.content: Workspace Slack channels relevant to support: #support-routing (routing run summaries, 41 members), #support-eng (escalations), #support-leads (private). #support-routing webhook is monitored by the on-call lead.

tools.name: fetch_unassigned_tickets
tools.description: Retrieve the current snapshot of unassigned Freshdesk tickets (id, subject, requester, priority).

tools.name: lookup_customer_tier
tools.description: Look up a requester's domain in the ws_tiers worksheet to find its customer account and tier.

tools.name: retrieve_queue_routing_config
tools.description: Read the queue routing rules from the ws_queue_config worksheet in ss_customers.

tools.name: evaluate_routing_assignments
tools.description: Apply the routing rules to each unassigned ticket using its tier and priority, determine the destination queue, and flag ambiguous or untiered cases.

tools.name: draft_ticket_routing_plan
tools.description: Compile the proposed per-ticket queue assignments, flagged exceptions, and a draft routing summary (with total count) into a routing plan for the user to review.

tools.name: assign_ticket_to_queue
tools.description: Reassign a live Freshdesk ticket to a destination support queue, changing its group/owner in production.

tools.name: add_routed_note_to_ticket
tools.description: Add an internal 'routed' note to a live Freshdesk ticket recording its assigned queue.

tools.name: post_routing_summary_to_channel
tools.description: Post the routing summary, including the total routed count, to the #support-routing Slack channel.

tools.name: list_slack_channels
tools.description: List available Slack channels and their membership for reference.

tools.name: lookup_agent_directory
tools.description: Look up support queues and their on-call leads in the agent/group directory.

tools.name: read_routing_policy
tools.description: Read the Support Routing Policy for SLA windows and routing governance rules.
